description: Tab system restructure and PPDA tab + form field removal in app.orders.tsx. Renames tab keys (lpo→orders, orders→bids), removes the ppda tab entirely (including its 229-line inline JSX block and the PpdaComplianceWorkspace component definition at lines 5554–5740), strips all 24 PPDA useState variables and 3 PPDA JSX sections from OrderFormSheet, and cleans up dead imports. Independent of FEAT-002.
steps: Step 1 — activeTab useState type (line 306): change 'useState<"documents" | "lpo" | "orders" | "ppda">' to 'useState<"documents" | "bids" | "orders">'.
Step 2 — useEffect that loads documents (line 367): change 'activeTab === "lpo"' to 'activeTab === "orders"' inside the condition '(activeTab === "documents" || activeTab === "lpo")'.
Step 4 — Add lpoOrders memo just after branchScopedEmployees memo (~line 467): 'const lpoOrders = useMemo(() => orders.filter((o) => o.isLpoAccount === true), [orders]);'.

Step 5 — KPI card onClick handlers (lines 654–656 and 664): remove the onClick prop from both 'Stages In Progress' and 'Compliance Gaps' KpiCard components. The cards remain rendered but no longer navigate to the removed ppda tab.

Step 6 — Tab bar render array (line 675): replace the entire tab-bar map block — change array from ['documents','lpo','orders','ppda'] to ['documents','bids','orders'] and update label logic to: documents→same, bids→`Bids (${filtered.length})`, orders→`Orders (${lpoOrders.length})`.
Step 7 — activeTab === 'lpo' panel (line 716): change to activeTab === 'orders'.

Step 8 — PPDA tab block removal (lines 728–956): delete the entire '{activeTab === "ppda" && (
...
)}' block, lines 728 through 956 inclusive.
Step 9 — activeTab === 'orders' panel (line 957 after deletions, ~728 after): change to activeTab === 'bids'.

Step 10 — Remove PpdaComplianceWorkspace function definition and its helpers (workingDaysBetween + UGANDA_2026_PUBLIC_HOLIDAYS constant): delete from the UGANDA_2026_PUBLIC_HOLIDAYS const declaration down to the closing brace of PpdaComplianceWorkspace (~lines 5490–5740 in original). Use grep to confirm exact start line of UGANDA_2026_PUBLIC_HOLIDAYS before deleting.

Step 11 — OrderFormSheet: delete all 24 ppda* useState declarations (lines ~3512–3544): ppdaProcurementMethod, ppdaIsLocal, ppdaIsMsme, ppdaDomesticPct, ppdaBidSecurity, ppdaBidSecurityAmt, ppdaBidSecurityValid, ppdaBidSecurityIssuer, ppdaUraTcc, ppdaNssf, ppdaPpdaCert, ppdaUrsb, ppdaAudited, ppdaBidSecStatus, ppdaPrn, ppdaDecl, ppdaEvalCmte, ppdaContractsCmte, ppdaStandstillEnd, ppdaBidOpenedAt, ppdaTechEvalAt, ppdaFinEvalAt, ppdaAwardedAt, ppdaContractSignedAt.
Step 12 — OrderFormSheet useEffect reset block: delete the 24 ppda* reset calls (setPpdaProcurementMethod through setPpdaContractSignedAt).

Step 13 — OrderFormSheet submit() function: delete the mergedCompliance construction block (domesticPctNum, isWorks, schedule3Eligible, prefMargin, mergedCompliance object) and remove 'ppdaCompliance: mergedCompliance' from the onCreate({...}) call.

Step 14 — OrderFormSheet JSX: delete the 3 PPDA <motion.div> sections: (a) 'PPDA · Classification & Preference (Schedule 3 / 4)', (b) 'PPDA · 8-Point Statutory Compliance Status', (c) 'PPDA · Evaluation & Award Attribution'. These appear between the cart section and the delivery date / handled-by grid.

Step 15 — Import cleanup: remove from lucide-react imports: TrendingDown, DollarSign, Square, Trophy, FileCheck. Remove from types/sales-order.ts import: ProcurementMethod, PpdaComplianceDetails. Verify ComplianceStatus is still needed (yes — used in PpdaPreferenceBadge reading order.ppdaCompliance fields).
